title: Tragui
description: A Kotlin-based Android application developed using Jetpack Compose, designed to help users find cocktails based on their chosen beverage type, offering an engaging and smooth user experience.

title: OfferHub
description: A Kotlin-based Android application that centralizes promotions by collecting offers from banks. Developed using Kotlin, this app allows users to track, filter, and stay up-to-date on personalized promotions all in one place.

title: WriteDreams
description: WriteDreams is a minimalistic web app for sharing creative ideas (apps, books, films, etc.) without requiring registration. Users can submit one idea every 24 hours, browse and vote for rated ideas, while unrated ideas remain hidden.

title: Live-Chat
description: A real-time chat application with Node.js and WebSockets using Socket.IO for communication. It features message persistence via SQLite, allowing users to interact in real-time.

title: Empressaria
description: Empressaria is an e-commerce website designed for efficient product browsing. It loads a product catalog dynamically from a JSON file without requiring a database.

title: Korean Character Recognition with AI
description: A convolutional neural network (CNN) that classifies character images as Korean (Hangul) or Latin, trained on two Kaggle datasets with a grayscale, 250x250 preprocessing pipeline.
